name: Mark-room at the zone
note: Quiz #3. Both boats on starboard on the layline to the windward mark (left to port), overlapped when they reach the zone: boat 1 inside (leeward), boat 0 outside (windward), her bow a metre ahead. Boat 0 bears away round the mark early, across boat 1's bow. The outside boat (boat 0) must give the inside boat mark-room (rule 18.2) and takes the penalty.
